info.title: Hermes trusted Telegram bridge
info.description: Private owner-bound JSON-RPC stdio. UTF-8 JSON document per line; requests at most 65536 bytes, responses at most 1048576 bytes. Timeout or channel loss can leave unknown outcome. This program must never be exposed as the model MCP server.

methods.name: files.publish
methods.description: Uses existing publisher MCP; stable requestId binds exact bytes and metadata. Byte limit 2 GiB; path must belong to configured publisher read roots.

methods.name: files.fetch
methods.description: Restores a ready artifact of the trusted owner through publisher, checking size and SHA-256.

methods.name: actions.read
methods.description: Reads only an Action belonging to the fixed owner.

methods.name: actions.prepare
methods.description: Claims the exact human attempt before Telegram displays a decision or requests practical work. Decision-only confirm/final Actions have one Accept button; clarification and practical work have no button. Practical results are submitted only from the actual owner MessageEvent by actions.result. confirmationStage is canonical; null on recovery means substantive outputs are required, not approval. Retry uses the same key and selected resource IDs. Recovery after revision change is for cancellation only.

methods.name: actions.complete
methods.description: Requires a consumed private-owner Telegram callback bound to the exact attempt and revision. Canonical positive stage is derived from the real integrated planning decision; changes always writes review/changes. Integrated plans support only decision-only confirm/final Actions with one output; unsupported work fails HUMAN_OUTPUT_REQUIRED. Game-core atomically checks the current revision and claim snapshot for integrated planning decisions and planning stage; legacy review/final checks are preflight only. Repeated terminal or stale callbacks are rejected.

schema.description: Unmodified Elements move_complete owner DTO; see services/elements/CONTRACT.md.

methods.name: actions.cancel
methods.description: Terminates the exact current running human attempt via owner fail; move returns to planned. Revision may have advanced because cleanup must not confirm a new revision.

schema.description: Unmodified Elements move_fail owner DTO; see services/elements/CONTRACT.md.

methods.name: actions.fail_agent
methods.description: Fail the exact current agent Operation attempt after a native terminal session hook. Reads the owner graph, then uses elements_move_fail only if the same attempt is still running. Not exposed to model MCP.

methods.name: actions.feedback
methods.description: Only the trusted plugin supplies the exact current owner message text and provenance. Changes complete the current decision-only human Action as review/changes. Clarification answers complete clarification/answered from the actual current owner message. Cancellation uses element_activate with revision CAS and a durable feedback ID; preserves completed records and cancels the uncompleted descendant tree. Not exposed to the model MCP.

methods.name: actions.result
methods.description: Complete only a currently running human attempt. Practical output content/source come from a real owner MessageEvent; for multi-output Actions the caller maps exact contract names and explicit final decision text.

confirmationStage.description: Canonical stage for an integrated decision-only Action. Clarification has no approval button and accepts only a plain owner answer. Null means substantive human outputs are required; absence preserves legacy caller stage.

confirmationText.description: Full current plan, selected actual result or clarification question for chat; null means no reviewable content is available. No UI link or model-supplied summary.
